SoX Resampler Library (libsoxr) 0.1.3, latest upstream master as checked 2026-10-02.
Repository: https://git.code.sf.net/p/soxr/code
Mirror: https://github.com/chirlu/soxr
Commit: 945b592b70470e29f917f4de89b4281fbbd540c0
Required upstream DSP sources, headers, config template, and license notices
are included unmodified. Build adaptation is in
../soxr-build, using current CMake, C11, static CRT and runtime-dispatched
double-precision AVX with a scalar fallback. No single-precision engine,
variable-rate engine, OpenMP or libsamplerate compatibility layer is built.

Sinc configuration: 33-bit design precision (maximum supported), Float64
input/output and arithmetic, high-precision clock, linear phase, passband
end 0.998 Nyquist and stopband start 1.0 Nyquist (minimum supported 0.2%
transition bandwidth), SOXR_ROLLOFF_NONE for a flat Chebyshev passband,
no aliasing allowance. Filtering precedes final PCM
quantization and runs outside the ASIO callback.

LGPL-2.1-or-later. See LICENCE and COPYING.LGPL. FFT notices for binary
redistribution are collected in ../soxr-build/FFT-NOTICES.txt. The complete
source and CMake build accompany the renderer so this static library can be
modified and the renderer rebuilt/relinked with the modified library.
